name: Retribution
overview: Scripture teaches that retribution is a principle established by God, reflecting His justice and holiness. From the early command in Genesis 9:6 that human life, made in God's image, demands just consequences for shedding blood, to the clear law in Exodus 21:23 of life for life, retribution underscores the seriousness of sin. The New Testament reveals that ultimate recompense belongs to Christ, who will reward each person according to their deeds (Matthew 16:27), while believers are exhorted to leave vengeance to God (Romans 12:19). Additionally, civil authorities serve as God's agents to execute just punishment on evildoers (Romans 13:4), and the principle of sowing and reaping (Galatians 6:7) affirms that God’s justice is both certain and personal.
